note: The Atlas engine is built from the public Enntity/atlas fork at this exact commit; build.sh refuses any other tree.

upstream_candidate.note: upstream/glm53-flash-20261009-rc2 (a1c9b1bc) plus ten engine commits, each behind its own switch: one-shot all-reduce stages on the SMs (ATLAS_RDMA_ONESHOT_SM_STAGE), the MoE routing chain in two launches (ATLAS_GLM_MOE_ROUTE_FUSE), the verify dense FFN split across the pair (ATLAS_GLM_DENSE_TP_SPLIT), KDA record commits over a fixed grid (ATLAS_GLM_KDA_COMMIT_CTAS), the DFlash2 selector's threshold top-k (ATLAS_GLM_DRAFT_TP_TOPK), drafter uploads without draining the stream (ATLAS_DFLASH_ASYNC_UPLOADS), the MLA layer front in two launches (ATLAS_GLM_MLA_FUSE), chunk-tiled MXFP8 twins (ATLAS_GLM_MXFP8_TILED), DFlash2 selector edge-weight twins (ATLAS_DFLASH2_EDGE) and NVFP4/MXFP8 twins of the drafter's delta projections (ATLAS_DFLASH_CONV_TWIN).

sparkglm_only.note: The seven SparkGLM-only commits of sparkglm/atlas-20261009-rc2-layered (a1c9b1bc..fea1ef6c), cherry-picked unchanged onto the upstream candidate: FlashKDA/native sparse-MLA prefill bridges, GB10 display-carveout KV placement (latent pools only, ATLAS_KV_CARVEOUT_ORDER), and sharded latent pools (ATLAS_GLM_KV_SHARD, opt-in through SPARKGLM_KV_SHARD) sized and placed in the carveout. Fork-only; the carveout is used only with DISPLAY_CARVEOUT=1.

integration.note: The measured candidate: sparkglm/atlas-20261009-rc2-layered (fea1ef6c) plus the same ten engine commits. Its tree equals the pinned layered commit's tree (ae5e79f8), so the image is the engine measured on the pair.
